name: calc-42
description: Calculator: background clicks 6 x 7 = and check the display row reads 42.
notes: Launches Calculator every run (no launch_if_missing) and pins the window that launch produced: packaged (UWP) apps resolve by window title, and several live windows can share the title 'Calculator' — an old pid 23336 window on this host answers every read with ax_tree_empty (39-element trees come from the ApplicationFrameHost-hosted window instead). Command-line `--window` alone therefore picks the frontmost match, which can be the sick one; the launch makes the run deterministic. Do not add an `app` field here: `Microsoft.WindowsCalculator_8wekyb3d8bbwe!App` is an AUMID, and the driver's `app` selector matches process names, so it refuses with `no window of app`. Verified: `Display is 42` after Clear/6/Multiply by/7/Equals.
